constraints.name: carry_condition
constraints.description: A number x is called irresponsible if and only if computing x + (x+1) requires a carry operation.

constraints.name: concatenation_construction
constraints.description: The upper bound s is formed by concatenating the decimal string of x exactly n times and interpreting the result as an integer.
constraints.formal: s = int( str(x) repeated n times )

constraints.name: inclusive_range
constraints.description: The count must cover all irresponsible numbers in the closed interval from 1 to s, inclusive.

constraints.name: modulus_requirement
constraints.description: The final answer must be reported modulo 10^9+7.
